source_snapshot.test_name_items: Set LAN source in static via BIOS
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Set LAN source by:
    - Boot into setup menu and move to the BMC networking page.
    - Set the source to "Static" then change the settings.
          Type IP address in the column of "IPv4 address".
          Type netmask in the column of "Subnet mask".
          Type default gateway IP address in the column of "Default Gateway".
2. Boot into OS
3. Send command: ipmitool lan print to check LAN information.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: BMC LAN should display correctly as setting.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO correctly rejects remote substitution for the pre-OS field entry, but its summary omits the source default-gateway field and treats the explicit post-boot readback as incidental rather than a material automated checkpoint.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / CHANGED correctly adds a complete static plan, conflict check, MAC correlation, alternate recovery and rollback, but under-classifies the source-defined post-boot verification portion.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 818/2291 calls the entire case physical and provides only operator evidence, omitting the required exact IP/mask/gateway readback and address/route usability after BIOS propagation.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Its non-counting sequence-983 draft was inspected only as history. This review independently changes MANUAL ONLY to package/user confirmation for the manual BIOS plus automatable network-verification split and adds explicit gateway/on-link validation.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves BIOS as the specified control path and forbids an unrecorded BMC-side substitute; ED-36 treats Project network values as readiness; ED-38 keeps BIOS save, reboot, readdressing and verdict engineer-owned.

original_test_intent: Verify that the BIOS BMC-network page accepts a complete Project-approved static IPv4 tuple—address, netmask and default gateway—propagates it to the intended BMC interface across save/boot, and yields exact, reachable and persistent post-boot BMC LAN state without losing recoverability.
original_method: A qualified operator enters the actual BIOS setup, selects Static and types the approved IPv4 address, subnet mask and default gateway, then saves/exits and boots the OS. Automated post-checks read the mapped BMC channel, prove the same BMC identity, validate reachability/routing and compare every field; no IPMI/WebUI configuration write may stand in for BIOS propagation.
manual_activity: A qualified operator confirms the physical chassis and approved address tuple, navigates and records the versioned BIOS fields, saves/exits, supervises boot and maintains local/serial access during BMC readdressing. Automation performs only post-boot identity, exact-field, route and persistence verification.
required_inputs: Platform/BIOS/BMC revisions, authoritative setup path, field format/range, save/activation behavior and approved final BIOS value
Mapping from the BIOS page to physical management port, shared/dedicated mode, BMC channel, MAC, VLAN and currently active path
IPAM-reserved BMC-specific IPv4 address, mask/prefix and on-link default gateway, approved management sources/routes, DNS/hostname policy and proof the address is outside conflicting use
Complete pre-change BIOS/BMC network state, quiescent host/reboot permission, local console and independent management rediscovery, exact BIOS rollback tuple and owner
Protected read-only BMC access after boot, full channel readback, MAC/serial identity, reachability test scope, persistence checkpoint and synchronized evidence
safety_requirements: Do not enter any static field until IPAM ownership, duplicate-address preflight, subnet arithmetic and gateway on-link validity are approved for the BMC—not copied from a DUT/host template.
Do not substitute IPMI/WebUI configuration writes for BIOS input/save. Such recovery may restore access but cannot validate the BIOS-to-BMC propagation under test.
Record the original BIOS values and complete BMC network tuple before change. Verify the menu maps to the intended physical interface and not another shared/dedicated port.

BIOS save may simultaneously reboot the host and readdress/restart the BMC. Use a dedicated/quiescent SUT and local/serial plus independent discovery that does not depend on the old or new BMC address.
Do not automate unverified keystrokes, expose credentials, clear logs, retry a partial save or guess a missing gateway. Stop before save if any field is rejected or normalized unexpectedly.

Abort on wrong MAC/interface, conflict evidence, off-subnet gateway, unexpected tuple, no boot/reconnect, identity mismatch, inaccessible approved route or rollback failure. Preserve console/network evidence.
After verification, restore the approved final BIOS tuple if required, save/boot once under approval and prove both BIOS and BMC readback plus host/management health.
agent_execution_scope: Before action, validate the BIOS field/menu specification, interface map, address/routing plan, reboot window, independent recovery, rollback and evidence scope without touching DUT state.

After the operator's save/boot, collect full protected read-only mapped-channel state, same-BMC MAC/serial/firmware, neighbor/switch evidence if approved, and reachability from each intended management domain.
Compare source mode, IP, mask and gateway exactly with the operator-recorded BIOS tuple and collect the approved persistence checkpoint; report any BMC-side write as recovery or different coverage.
Do not enter BIOS, send keystrokes, write networking, reboot, expose secrets, scan broadly, auto-retry or issue DUT PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the BIOS/menu/interface mapping, complete conflict-free address/route plan, reboot window, recovery, rollback, persistence point and final state.
Enter and verify all three fields in BIOS, save/boot under console observation, and maintain independent access during readdressing.
Restore and verify the approved tuple after evidence collection and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly keeps the BIOS write manual, but its prose mentions only IPv4 address and mask despite the source also requiring default gateway. `lan print` is not merely optional: it must verify the mapped channel and be paired with identity and route/reachability evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Keep all BIOS entry/save manual. After boot, use protected read-only full `ipmitool lan print <approved-channel>` or platform equivalent, correlate MAC/serial, and test only owner-approved management routes; no BMC-side configuration command is recommended.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BIOS Static selection, IPv4 address, subnet mask, default gateway, OS boot, `lan print`, no Script and 10/10-minute estimates remain unmodified.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Reserve/conflict-check the tuple; capture old BIOS/BMC state; enter all static fields in BIOS; save/boot under independent observation; rediscover by MAC; verify exact readback, local/routed reachability and persistence; then restore and read back the approved final tuple.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BIOS-to-BMC network implementation, management port topology, VLAN, switch/IPAM and routed administration network.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS, BMC, NIC/CPLD, SDR, ipmitool, switch/IPAM and OS versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform BIOS BMC-network field/activation specification, channel/port map and Project IPAM/routing approval.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic address ownership, interface identity, route/reachability, persistence and rollback evidence without replacing BIOS control.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A correct post-boot tuple set through IPMI/WebUI does not prove BIOS field validation, save, propagation or persistence; BIOS screenshots alone do not prove the live BMC uses a unique reachable tuple.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Versioned menu, mapped interface, complete reserved tuple, reboot/recovery, post-check and final-state approval.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A single typo in mask or gateway can leave the BMC locally visible yet unreachable from the intended routed management domain.

project_override_considerations: Project-specific addresses and menu paths are expected, but must be recorded in the Review execution package. Any substitute BMC-side write is different-path coverage and cannot satisfy the BIOS testcase; recovery use must be disclosed.
expected_evidence: BIOS/BMC/platform identity, authoritative menu/field behavior, physical-port/channel/MAC/VLAN map, complete IPAM-approved tuple and conflict/subnet/gateway proof
Full pre-change BIOS/BMC network state, reboot/recovery/rollback authorization and local/serial console baseline
Operator evidence of Static selection, exact IP/mask/gateway entry, accepted field formatting, save/exit and single boot timeline
Post-boot same-BMC identity, full mapped-channel exact tuple readback, local/on-subnet and approved routed reachability plus persistence evidence
Restored final BIOS and BMC tuple/readback, host/management health, unexpected logs, any recovery substitution and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The BIOS procedure and exact-readback Criteria are compatible; missing Project tuple, menu and persistence details are required inputs rather than contradictory meanings.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The target, fields, BIOS method and expected result are clear. A Project network package and safe recovery make the hybrid case executable, so it is not permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains its manual BIOS boundary, restores the omitted gateway requirement and makes post-boot readback/identity/routing a first-class checkpoint.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps its safety controls but changes MANUAL ONLY to package/user confirmation because the source explicitly includes automatable verification after the manual BIOS operation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces physical-only review with the complete BIOS tuple propagation and live-network acceptance chain.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Agrees that BIOS must not be replaced, while correcting classification and expanding exact gateway/routed reachability evidence.

review_improvement: Prevents a false PASS from either a screenshot of values that never propagate or a matching local readback whose wrong mask/gateway strands routed management, while keeping the BIOS integration—not an IPMI write—as the tested control path.
independent_technical_reasoning: This case validates two coupled layers: manual BIOS field/save behavior and the resulting live BMC configuration. Neither layer alone is sufficient. Because the post-boot exact readback and reachability are explicitly automatable and material, the case is hybrid package/user confirmation rather than manual-only; the disruptive values and recovery remain engineer-approved inputs.
